# CapacityScalingLaw

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mathematical relationship describing how memory storage capacity grows as a function of network size, often exponential in dense associative models. Provides theoretical bounds and design targets for neuromorphic hardware, ensuring scalability to real-world cognitive workloads.
